type:
∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (a : R) {i : σ} (n : ℕ) {k : σ →₀ ℕ},
  k i = 0 →
    (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ((taylor α) ((monomial k) a)).coeff d = (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) ((monomial k) a))) →
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
        ((taylor α) ((monomial (Finsupp.single i n + k)) a)).coeff d =
          (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) ((monomial (Finsupp.single i n + k)) a))
what: Proves the coefficient Taylor identity for a monomial after adding one new coordinate, assuming the identity for the residual monomial.
how: Derives translated residual support independence, applies coefficient separation and the one-variable binomial theorem, then factors binomial and power products.
hypotheses: Arbitrary variables and commutative semiring; residual exponent zero in selected coordinate; induction hypothesis for all residual coefficients; n and a unrestricted.
caller_summary: One explicit caller private coeff_taylor_monomial_aux at Taylor129; full caller replay using fresh induction-step proof validated.
mathlib_api_audit: Uses Polynomial.coeff_X_add_C_pow and existing monomial/evaluation/multiplication laws plus three separately reviewed private project helpers; not a library-only composition claim.
moral_duplications: Coordinate induction step is distinct from universal aeval_monomial and full coefficient theorem; scalar helpers separate different calculations.
generalization: Native type needs no Fintype/DecidableEq/field/charzero/nonzero or npositive hypotheses; no additional weakening or circular use of later coeff_taylor claimed.
missing_api: No missing primitive blocks current decomposition; prospective public multivariate Hasse/Taylor API assessed separately.
junk: Retain private induction-step helper to keep Finsupp induction case concise; no sorry, limitraise or long proof.
